decision_notes: Own assembly website designates its recording provider. Plenary 20 October 2026: member speaking at lectern with interpreter; health-accountability hearing of that date showing the state health secretariat's maternal mortality 2021–2026 slides. The hearing is separate from a plenary sitting. Two selected recordings decode and advance in Chromium and WebKit; captured Chromium frames were visually reviewed, with additional WebKit visual review for the new Ceará and Paraíba samples. Muted samples do not certify audible quality, current live or complete room coverage.

Official institutional viewing link only. No independent blanket audiovisual reuse grant was established from the reviewed source navigation. Personal-use permission remains pending; no provider embed, extracted media, rehosting or IPTV export is added.
